headlines.description: Andy Dalton threw one touchdown pass and ran for another score, an opportunistic defense forced five turnovers, and the Cincinnati Bengals beat the Philadelphia Eagles 34-13 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bengals force 5 turnovers, rout sloppy Eagles

events.name: New York Giants at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: Matt Ryan threw three touchdowns passes and the Atlanta Falcons handed the New York Giants their first regular-season shutout since 1996, blowing out the defending Super Bowl champions 34-0 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan throws 3 TDs as Falcons shut out Giants

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: The Green Bay Packers clinched their second straight NFC North title with a 21-13 victory over the archrival Chicago Bears on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers hold off Bears, secure NFC North title

headlines.description: Rookie Kirk Cousins threw for 329 yards and two touchdowns filling in for injured star Robert Griffin III, leading the Washington Redskins to their fifth straight win, 38-21 over the Cleveland Browns on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cousins has 2 TDs in 1st start, leads Redskins

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at St. Louis Rams

headlines.description: Adrian Peterson ran for a season-best 212 yards, including an 82-yard touchdown that fueled the Minnesota Vikings' big second quarter in a 36-22 victory that spoiled the St. Louis Rams' home finale Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Peterson's 212 yards power Vikings to win

headlines.description: The Miami Dolphins kept former teammate Chad Henne out of the end zone, making three fourth-down stops deep in their own territory and benefiting from an odd penalty in beating the Jacksonville Jaguars 24-3 Sunday.

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Drew Brees passed for 307 yards and four touchdowns, and the New Orleans Saints recorded their first shutout since 1995 in a 41-0 victory over the Buccaneers on Sunday, virtually ending Tampa Bay's already slim playoff hopes.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brees throws 4 TDs; Saints shut out Bucs

headlines.description: Chris Harris returned an interception 98 yards for a momentum-turning touchdown, and the Denver Broncos beat the skidding Baltimore Ravens 34-17 Sunday for their ninth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Harris' pick-6 propels Broncos past Ravens

headlines.description: The Houston Texans are AFC South champions for the second straight year after beating the Indianapolis Colts 29-17 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans roll past Colts, secure AFC South crown

headlines.description: Seattle rookie quarterback Russell Wilson ran for three touchdowns and threw for another in leading the Seahawks to their second straight rout, a 50-17 win over the Bills on Sunday in Buffalo's annual home game in Toronto.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson paces Seahawks in blowout of Bills

headlines.description: Greg Toler brought back an interception 102 yards for a fourth-quarter touchdown, the longest return in franchise history, to seal Arizona's 31-10 victory over Detroit on Sunday, snapping the Cardinals' nine-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cards grab 3 INTs off Lions, snap 9-game skid

events.name: Carolina Panthers at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Mike Tolbert scored twice against his former team as the Carolina Panthers beat San Diego 31-7 Sunday and eliminated the Chargers from playoff contention for the third straight season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers' Tolbert back in S.D., has 2 TDs in win

headlines.description: Brandon Carr intercepted a pass from Ben Roethlisberger to set up Dan Bailey's 21-yard field goal in overtime, and the Dallas Cowboys beat the Pittsburgh Steelers 27-24 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carr OT pick sets up Cowboys' win vs. Steelers

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Oakland Raiders

headlines.description: Sebastian Janikowski kicked five field goals, Darren McFadden rushed for 110 yards and the Oakland Raiders shut out Kansas City for the second time ever, beating the Chiefs 15-0 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raiders post 2nd shutout ever against Chiefs

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at New England Patriots

headlines.description: San Francisco 49ers earned a playoff berth by withstanding a stunning comeback by New England from a 28-point deficit to beat the Patriots 41-34 on Sunday night in the rain.
headlines.shortLinkText: 49ers prevail after Patriots rally from 28 down

events.name: New York Jets at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: Chris Johnson went 94 yards for the longest touchdown run in the NFL since 2006, and the Tennessee Titans beat the Jets 14-10 on Monday night to eliminate New York from playoff contention.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans hang on to knock Jets out of playoff hunt
